svg.title: FIG 04 · DLMS over Bluetooth
svg.desc: Sequence drawing of a DLMS/COSEM read over Bluetooth. On the phone, a scanner finds meters over BLE and Classic at once, one channel interface hides GATT and SPP, and the Gurux-based client runs the IEC 62056-46 HDLC session: SNRM and UA, AARQ with LOW authentication and AARE, then a GET per OBIS code whose response can span several blocks, then DISC. Out come 13 months of billing history, tariff zones T1 to T6, max demand, voltage, current and power factor.
svg.text: phone and smart meter talk iec 62056-46 hdlc · every frame drawn below
billing profile · 13 months · tariff zones T1–T6 (kWh, kVAh) · max demand + timestamp
instantaneous: voltage · current · power factor · active + apparent power
